newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Salomon sees further Portugal rate cut.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Salomon sees further Portugal rate cut.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal will probably ease monetary policy later this year, although the move will only be gradual to keep the escudo stable against the mark, Salomon Brothers said in its latest international report.

With the inflationary trend renewing its downward trend after the summer and with continuing "subtrend" economic growth in Portugal, the Bank's official repo rate will probably drop to 7.0 percent from the current 7.25 percent by the year's end, it said.

A shrinking public deficit and ebbing underlying inflation should continue to underpin Portuguese bonds over the next year as "consensus views shift to anticipate Portuguese entry into EMU in 1999 (or more likely within one or two years of the start)," it added.
